name: Sour shrimp
summary: Tôm chua is Huế’s sour shrimp, made from the land shrimp at chợ Cầu Hai, and eaten with boiled pork and pickled bean sprouts.
origin: Huế. The shrimp is the land shrimp from chợ Cầu Hai.
howToEat: Order the plate of tôm chua, boiled pork, and pickled bean sprouts.
where: Huế restaurants serve the plate. The shrimp is bought at chợ Cầu Hai.
